page.layout: One printed page: running text in one column, with a list of indented entries (year, place, disputants) below the paragraph. Running head at top. No margin notes.

main_text.p: dem materiam, eventum: plerumque ut inde Ecclesia multum lucrata fuerit, sive ad plurimorum instructionem, qui secus alias nihil vel parum de doctrina reformationis inaudierant; sive ad Reformationis plura per loca promotionem & introductionem; sive etiam ad Papalis doctrinae egregiam confutationem, & quod in nuperis Colloquiis observamus, (atque ut in aliis recentibus Papisticorum Doctorum scriptis idem graviter annotetur, sedulo monemus) Papismi declinationem. Haec ergo Colloquia fuerunt, inter Protestantes, & Papistas habita.
main_text.l: A. MDXIX. Lipsiacum, inter Lutherum, & Eckium.
Eodem anno, Groninganum, inter Dominicanos, atque Sacerdotes Ecclesiae D. Martini.
MDXXV. Rheticum, inter Comandrum, & Vicarium Episcopi Curiensis.
MDXXVI. Hassiacum Homburgi, inter Franc. Lambertum, & Cratonem; atque ex Pontificiis, Nicolaum Herbornensem &c.
MDXXVI. Oldersbemense, in Frisia, inter Laurentium Dominicanum, & Georg. Apor-tanum.
MDXXVII. Nordense, in Frisia, inter Resium, & Synellium.
MDXXVIII. Upsalense, in Suecia, inter M. Olaum, & Gallium.
MDXXVIII. Bernense, inter Hallerum, & Alexium Grad &c.
MDXXXI. Ulmense, inter Oecolampadium, & Georgium Oswaldum.

page.notes: Several Roman numerals in the year entries are set with spacing and small type and are read as printed; the exact spacing of some numerals (e.g. "xxvi", "xxviii") is uncertain. Lines of the list are indented and not part of the running text. Stray marks and specks in the margins are not printed text.
